summary: This bill prohibits the use of federal funds to suspend, delay, or interrupt work on projects under contract during a government shutdown or lapse in appropriations.

scores.thoughts: This bill aims to prevent the suspension or interruption of federal contracts during a lapse in appropriations. While it doesn't directly authorize new spending or cut existing spending, it mandates that funds cannot be used to stop work on contracts, which could imply a continuation of spending commitments even during a shutdown. This indirectly supports continued government expenditure on existing contracts.
